title: Fine-grained Narrative Classification in Biased News Articles
reasoning: The paper focuses on the classification of ideological narratives and propaganda techniques in news articles related to socio-political events (CAA and Farmers' protest). While it includes categories that touch on religious sentiment (e.g., 'Anti-Hindu') and moral framing as part of its narrative taxonomy, the primary objective is to evaluate media bias and propaganda detection rather than to benchmark or evaluate the religious, faith-based, or ethical systems of models.
